create.title: New contact
create.intro: Add a person by hand. A contact needs at least a name, an e-mail or a phone.
create.phoneHint: Without a country prefix, a Spanish number is assumed.

edit.title: Edit contact
edit.intro: A contact needs at least a name, an e-mail or a phone.
edit.emailsHint: One per line. The first is the main one.
edit.phonesHint: One per line. The first is the main one. Without a country prefix, a Spanish number is assumed.
edit.languageHint: A code such as en, es or pt-BR.
edit.consentHint: Changing a consent adds an entry with your name and the time to the consent history. Change it only when the person told you so.
edit.doNotContactHint: This person will not be contacted, whatever their consents say.
edit.duplicate: An e-mail or phone you entered already belongs to another contact. Remove it here, or merge the two contacts from the contact's page.

duplicate.title: This person may already be a contact
duplicate.body: {count, plural, one {A contact already has this e-mail or phone.} other {# contacts already have these e-mails or phones.}} Add the new details to the existing contact instead of creating a second one.

consents.title: Consent history
consents.load: The consent history could not be loaded.
consents.impersonated: by support on a team member's behalf

merge.title: Merge contacts
merge.body: The other contact's e-mails, phones, notes, leads, activities, tasks and registrations move to this contact, and the other contact is closed. This cannot be undone.

import.title: Import contacts
import.upload: Upload a CSV or Excel file
import.onDuplicate: When a row matches an existing contact
import.MERGE: Add its new details to the contact
import.phoneCountry: Country for phone numbers without a prefix
import.consentProcessing: These people agreed to the processing of their data

rowErrors.INVALID_PHONE: A phone number is not valid
rowErrors.DUPLICATE_RACE: Another contact took an e-mail or phone of this row meanwhile

import.adminsOnly: Only an agency admin can import contacts. Ask your admin to do it.
import.intro: Upload a file, check which column holds what, look at the result, then import. Nothing is imported until you press the import button.
import.fileHint: CSV or Excel (.xlsx), up to {mb} MB and {rows} rows, with column names in the first row. Only agency admins can import.
import.needIdentity: Choose a column for a name, an e-mail or a phone.
import.consentWarning: Marketing consent is never assumed. Choose a column here only if it records this person's own yes or no. Rows with yes, si, true, 1 or x get the consent, recorded as coming from this import; every other row gets none.
import.consentColumnNone: No marketing consent column is chosen: nobody in this file gets marketing consent.
import.mergeHint: Existing values are kept. Only empty fields are filled, and new e-mails, phones, types and tags are added. A consent the person already chose is not changed.
import.skipHint: The existing contact is left exactly as it is.
import.phoneCountryHint: Two letters, such as ES or GB.
import.previewSummary: {new} new · {existing} already contacts · {repeated} repeated in the file · {invalid} with errors
import.previewConsent: {count} of these rows would get marketing consent.
import.previewMore: Only the first {count} rows were checked. The final report covers the whole file.
import.previewStale: The columns or options changed. Check the rows again before importing.
import.running: Importing in the background. You can leave this page; the result stays in the list below.
import.partial: Rows imported before it stopped stay imported.

fileErrors.UNSUPPORTED_XLS: The old Excel format (.xls) is not supported. Save the file as .xlsx or CSV.
fileErrors.ENCRYPTED: This file is protected by a password. Remove the password and upload it again.
fileErrors.TOO_MANY_ROWS: This file has too many rows. Split it and import the parts one by one.
fileErrors.TOO_MANY_COLUMNS: This file has too many columns.
fileErrors.NO_RECORDS: This file has no rows under its column names.
fileErrors.FILE_MISSING: The uploaded file is no longer available. Upload it again.

failure.PLAN_REQUIRED: Your plan's contact limit was reached.
failure.MAPPING_INVALID: The column choices could not be read. Upload the file again.
failure.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.

import.previewUnchecked: This file is too large to check in advance. You can still import it: the report at the end lists the rows that could not be imported.
import.lost: This page lost track of the import. It may still be running: see its result in the list below.

errors.CLIENT_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND: This search profile no longer exists.
errors.CLIENT_PROFILE_LIMIT: A contact can have at most {max} search profiles. Delete one first.
errors.CONTACT_NOT_FOUND: This contact does not exist or was merged into another one.
errors.CONTACT_DUPLICATE: An e-mail or phone already belongs to another contact.
errors.CONTACT_PHONE_INVALID: A phone number is not valid.
errors.CONTACT_IMPORT_STARTED: This import was already started. Upload the file again to import it once more.
errors.CONTACT_IMPORT_FILE_INVALID: This file is not a CSV or Excel file we can read, or it has no rows.
errors.CONTACT_MERGE_LIMIT: The merged contact would have too many e-mails, phones or tags. Remove some first.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone changed this contact meanwhile. Reload and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do that.
errors.PLAN_REQUIRED: Your plan's contact limit was reached.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.CLIENT_PROFILE_MATCH_STATE: This match was already handled. Reload to see where it is now.
errors.CLIENT_PROFILE_MATCH_EXPIRED: This listing can no longer be offered to the client.
errors.SELECTION_ITEMS_INVALID: This listing can no longer be added to a selection.

list.subtitle: Everyone your agency deals with, newest first.

find.title: Find by e-mail or phone
find.none: No contact has that e-mail or phone.
find.invalid: Enter a valid e-mail or phone number.

list.load: The contacts could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.

merge.find: Find the duplicate by e-mail or phone
merge.none: No other contact has that e-mail or phone.

boost.liked: Similar to listings the client liked ({what})
boost.disliked: Similar to listings the client turned down ({what})

profiles.title: Search profiles
profiles.intro: What this client is looking for. The matching engine finds listings for each active profile.
profiles.loadError: The search profiles could not be loaded.
profiles.confirmDelete: Delete profile {n}? Its matches go with it. This cannot be undone.
profiles.beds: {count, plural, one {# bedroom} other {# bedrooms}} or more
profiles.baths: {count, plural, one {# bathroom} other {# bathrooms}} or more
profiles.modeHelp: Off: no matching. Review: matches wait in the review queue. Send automatically: matches are sent to the client.

form.multiHelp: Choose more than one with Ctrl or Cmd + click, or with Shift + the arrow keys.
form.wishesHelp: For example: sea view, walking distance to the beach. Up to {max} characters.
form.conflict: Someone changed this profile meanwhile. The form shows the latest version: check it and save again.

matchQueue.title: Matches to review
matchQueue.intro: Listings the matching engine found for your clients' search profiles. Approve one to add it to a selection for the client (nothing is sent), or dismiss it.
matchQueue.pageHidden: None of these matches can still be offered. Older matches follow.
matchQueue.load: The matches could not be loaded.

done.APPROVED: Added to a selection for the client. Nothing was sent: share it from the selection.
done.PENDING_REVIEW: Match restored to the review queue.
done.EXPIRED: This listing can no longer be offered, so the match was closed.
